required_facts.fact: The cohort built personal, professional and health assistants.
Eduardo's bAIpacking uses DotWatcher, PostgreSQL and RAG.
Pavlo's Meal-Map uses 28 documents and 9 tools.
Mladen's VoiceIssue creates GitHub issues from Telegram voice.
Spyros's medical app runs local Whisper and Llama offline.
Cyber Sachet supports Nepali cybersecurity awareness.
SnapSplit uses vision and human escalation.
AMR uses 15 sources and reciprocal-rank retrieval.
The regulation assistant covers European, US and Dutch jurisdictions.

author_attribution: Attribute each project to its named student.
